name: Wildvine
abilities: Elastic vine limbs and whip tendrils (grab, restrain, swing)
Explosive / gas-bomb / vine-growing fruit pods on his back
weaknesses: Over-stretched limbs stay extended for a while
Extreme cold makes him wilt and can kill him
summary: A one-eyed walking plant with whip-vine limbs, a flytrap head and a back full of explosive fruit - stretchy, sneaky and surprisingly tough.
traits: Five vine legs in OS, four in OV
DNA donor was possessed by Zs'Skayr, which is how Ghostfreak entered the Omnitrix
notableFeats: Held back the Mycelium spores of Camp Opinicon (Camp Fear)
Caught Max and Gwen mid-fall and beat Hex and Charmcaster (Tough Luck)
Defeated three Null Guardians in the Null Void (Back With a Vengeance)

appearances.designNotes: Green skin and teeth, five vine legs, blue main eye plus a secondary blue eye on each shoulder, black fruit pods on the back, original Omnitrix on the chest.

Green skin, four legs, white teeth, shorter thicker fingers, shoulder eyes replaced by light-green patches, blue tongue, bigger flytrap; 16-year-old wears the Omnitrix on a green/white belt, 11-year-old on the chest (green).

scoring.rationale: Mid-tier utility fighter: stretching vines, restraints, explosive/gas fruit and regeneration cover many situations, but he lacks raw power and is undone by cold, electricity or a good tangle.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked) or Ultimate Alien (intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
OV 'Ben Again': 16-year-old Ben's mind in 11-year-old Ben's body used the 11-year-old design (counted as ben-11-ov).
Also used by Ken (Ken 10), Albedo (The Ultimate Heist) and Gwen 10 (And Then There Were None / And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
